component.name: SiskiyouPlethodon
component.summary: Web browser for PowerPC, built from Mozilla Firefox source code

description.p: SiskiyouPlethodon is an independent build of the Gecko engine for 32-bit PowerPC (PowerBook G4 and other G4 Macs) on Arch POWER, with a ppc32 JavaScript JIT and big-endian rendering fixes. It is built from Mozilla Firefox source code and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla.
